nominee.shortDescription: I would happily expedite my wait till November with her
nominee.longerDescription: HAPPY WW! This week I am (unfortunately only virtually) celebrating with Chiquin! This beauty is from Venezuela and she is apparently a DJ and model. However what she is known for and the reason that she gained an extreme amount of following in such a short time is because she is believed to be the cover girl (or at least inspiration) for the GTA 6 loading screen (see pic 2.) I was originally planning on waiting with my gta 6 themed nominees but I couldn't hold this one in any longer. Interestingly I think that the real woman looks a million times better than the fictional one, which unfortunately I cannot say too often lol. Normally GTA loading screens give me a super weird feeling, especially because of the loading music being super ambient and different which is amplified by the fact that it takes ages for the game to load no matter the platform lol. However I think for this one it will have different affects. Also for funsies I am introducing a hype meter that will indicate my enthusiasm just to keep track. Hype: 6/10. Just the looks gave her a 6 which is fantastic imo, she is a 10/10 looks wise but due to the lack of information about her personality and how far the game release is + the small portion of a role she apparently has in it did get me moving but not to extreme measures.
